semantics.codes: Codes and reasons match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$; free text from the core becomes UNSTRUCTURED and never crosses the API.

config.source: The core's RoserpinaConfig, read through one reference (reload_config swaps it whole). Only the allowlisted keys below are returned; credentials, tokens, certificates and persisted settings are never read.
config.states: SET exact value; NOT_SET optional setting not configured (the core treats a missing risk percentage as a block, a missing optional cap as inactive); INVALID present but unreadable, never shown as zero.
config.unlisted: Names of other core config fields, never their values; a sensitive name is never listed, only counted in `redacted`.

semantics.consistency: PER_FIELD_NON_ATOMIC: fields are read one at a time without a runtime-wide critical section; observed_at is the read instant. PER_SECTION_LOCKED: each section is produced by one core call under the lock of the component that owns it, or is one value replaced as a whole; two sections may reflect nearby instants.
semantics.markets: list_markets / get_market_book: the core MarketTracker's last received book per market, copied in one read; no network call. NOT_TRACKED for a market Pickfair does not hold. book_status is Betfair book data, never a tradability judgement (protection market_tradability). book_age_s (MCP-01n): seconds since Pickfair received the book, from the tracker's monotonic receive instant, read before the book so it is never underestimated; null when not provable. Prices and sizes are exact decimal strings; best three levels per side; market id pattern ^[0-9]{1,4}\.[0-9]{1,15}$, anything else is 404 on the Control API.
semantics.money: Amounts are finite floats in EUR exactly as the core holds them, never rounded or defaulted; execution_mode SIM means the simulated broker's fictitious balance. Since 1.3.0 new amounts and prices are canonical decimal strings (no exponent, no float): lossless from the core's Decimal, or the shortest repr of the core's float when the core holds a float (declared by amounts_source).
semantics.not_implemented: An approved read route the Control API does not serve yet answers 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED; a path outside the approved routes answers 404 NOT_FOUND; any method other than GET answers 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED. No command route is served.

orders.snapshot_states: OK complete; PARTIAL rows omitted or list truncated (reason); STALE read but the core's startup reconciliation is not done (reason); UNKNOWN database busy; UNAVAILABLE not readable. Missing values stay null, never zero.
orders.source: The core's durable `orders` ledger read in one read-only transaction; hedge orders of cashouts (HEDGE_*) included; never a network call.
orders.status_map_rule: A core status outside the map is UNKNOWN. UNMATCHED / PARTIALLY_MATCHED / MATCHED for an accepted order only with explicit size_matched and size_remaining. AMBIGUOUS stays AMBIGUOUS, never FAILED or absent. AMBIGUOUS and PENDING orders never carry size_matched, avg_price_matched or size_remaining: an unconfirmed report is not data; their bet_id stays (the core's reconciliation identity).

semantics.protections: Each protection is ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TRIGGERED, UNKNOWN or UNAVAILABLE; only ACTIVE has no reason. A protection that cannot be verified is UNKNOWN (core has it, value not readable) or UNAVAILABLE (core does not expose it yet), never ACTIVE or INACTIVE; the derived lists `disabled` and `unverifiable` must match the items.
semantics.security: Control API: token of at least 43 URL-safe characters (shorter or malformed tokens are refused at construction), rotations serialized end to end; at most 16 connections served at once (others closed without a thread), each closed within 10 s; protocol errors answer 400 BAD_REQUEST or 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED with a fixed JSON body, never echoing the input; no per-request log or traceback.
semantics.settlement: Counts only (no payload, reference or event name): unrecorded settlements, held Dutching batches, settlement_effects by outcome, cycle checkpoints by stage, SIM broker settlements (null in LIVE).
semantics.sl_tp: Per Roserpina table, read from the table meta as the core writes it: NOT_ARMED (no SL/TP amount), ARMED, TRIGGERED (core marked an SL or TP trigger) or UNKNOWN (unreadable). trailing (MCP-01m, F-03): NOT_IN_CORE without the core's trailing logic, OFF, WAITING_PROFIT, ARMED (peak and threshold computed by the core's trailing_stop module), TRIGGERED or UNKNOWN (persisted peak unreadable); peak from the table meta (MEMORY) or the persisted risk.trailing_peak record (PERSISTED). A trailing trigger never changes the SL/TP state.
semantics.sl_tp_closes: get_exposure.sl_tp_closes: closes persisted by the core's SL/TP close (F-04, settings `risk.sl_tp_close.*`), read in one read-only transaction with the position's orders and the ledger hedge rows: table, position, trigger, close state (CLAIMED/ROUTED/NOT_EXECUTED/UNCERTAIN, unreadable UNKNOWN), retryable as the core decides, detail code, residual exposure only from the table that still holds the position. Hedges of the close are the ledger rows whose cashout_request_id is recorded in the close (cashout_request_ids); null when the record does not carry them. Closes rejected before the claim are not persisted by the core and never appear. Without F-04: UNAVAILABLE CORE_PENDING_F04.
semantics.source: Responses declare source=core; the simulated adapter declares source=simulated.
semantics.transport: HTTP/1.1 GET only on 127.0.0.1, Authorization Bearer token required, Host must be 127.0.0.1:<port>, no redirects, Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8, body at most 65536 bytes.
semantics.unavailable: A field is null if and only if its name is listed in `unavailable`; a value the core does not hold is never replaced by a default.

SlTp.description:
SL/TP del tavolo (MCP-01h, contratto 1.5.0), letto dal `meta` del tavolo del core.

NOT_ARMED: nessun importo SL/TP sul tavolo (oggi sempre, sul `main` del core: nessun percorso
li arma prima di F-02 di Claude D). ARMED: almeno un importo. TRIGGERED: il core ha segnato lo
scatto di SL o TP (`sl_tp_triggered`). UNKNOWN: valori presenti ma illeggibili. Il trailing ha il suo
stato in `trailing` (MCP-01m): uno scatto del trailing non cambia lo stato di SL/TP.
SlTp.title: SlTp

SlTpClose.description: Chiusura SL/TP persistita da F-04 (`risk.sl_tp_close.<customer_ref>`; il riferimento non esce).
SlTpClose.title: SlTpClose

SlTpClosesMissing.description: UNAVAILABLE (core senza F-04: CORE_PENDING_F04, o DB non leggibile) o UNKNOWN (DB occupato).
SlTpClosesMissing.title: SlTpClosesMissing

Trailing.description:
Trailing stop del tavolo (MCP-01m, F-03 di Claude D), dal `meta` del tavolo e dal picco persistito.

NOT_IN_CORE: il core non ha la logica di trailing (prima di F-03): la percentuale, se configurata, non è
applicata. OFF: percentuale assente o non valida (il core lo tratta come spento). WAITING_PROFIT: attivo, nessun
profitto garantito ancora (nessun picco). ARMED: picco > 0, soglia calcolata dal core. TRIGGERED: il core ha
segnato lo scatto del trailing. UNKNOWN: picco persistito illeggibile (il core non decide: fail-closed).
Trailing.title: Trailing
